user: TICKET # The prefix and the invoice number are missing from the name of the invoice PDFs, only the year appears Hi I've found a major bug with PrestaShop 9.1. The invoice file names only show the current year, generating invoices with file name = 2026.pdf. Instead, in 8.2, it creates them, for example, FA2026007706.pdf. I think it is also useful to add a separator between the year and the invoice number. FA2026-007706.pdf, I think, is better to make the invoice number more visible. The error is serious, since there are companies that archive these PDFs, and to archive them the same rules must be followed between one version of PrestaShop and another, then it is necessary that the file names follow the rules used for the invoice identifiers I attach a photo that reflects a standard configuration from some companies that I follow bye ## Attendu the file name should be like the one generated in prestashop 8.x and if possible also add a separator or the option to let the merchant choose which separator to add between the name and the invoice number normally it should be so FA0077062026.pdf but on 9.1 is so 2026.pdf now it is missing FA007706 ## Étapes 1. create an order and change the order status to have it generate an invoice 2. Download the invoice PDF and see the file name ÉTAPE 1 LOCALISER. Réponds en JSON : {"keywords": ["...", "..."]} (3 à 8 mots-clés).
